Frequently Asked Questions

1. What is a KYC NFT?

Secure your digital identity with the power of blockchain technology. Our KYC Token is a revolutionary solution that transforms traditional Know Your Customer (KYC) procedures into NFT-based tokens, offering security, privacy, and convenience. Issued on the robust ICB Blockchain Network, these tokens provide verified digital identities for individuals and businesses, streamlining processes and enhancing trust.

2. How does KYC NFT work?

  1. Identity Verification: Users provide their necessary identification information through a secure and simple process. Our team verifies these details to ensure accuracy and compliance.
  2. NFT Minting: Once verified, an NFT KYC Token is created on the ICB Blockchain Network. This token is unique to you and securely stores your verified identity data without exposing sensitive information.
  3. Use Your KYC Token Across Platforms: Use your NFT KYC Token as proof of identity across different decentralized platforms, exchanges, and dApps within the ICB ecosystem and beyond. Say goodbye to lengthy KYC checks each time you sign up for a new service.

3. Why should I use a KYC NFT?

  1. Security:All information is encrypted and securely stored on the ICB Blockchain Network, ensuring that only you control your data.
  2. Interoperability:The NFT KYC Token is recognized across multiple platforms within the ICB ecosystem, giving you seamless access to a variety of services and applications.
  3. Privacy:Your sensitive information is not exposed unnecessarily. The NFT KYC Token serves as a reference point to confirm your KYC status without revealing personal details.
  4. Efficiency:Save time by using your KYC Token for multiple verifications across different services without having to go through the process repeatedly.

4. Can I use my KYC NFT across different platforms?

Yes, you can utilize your KYC (Know Your Customer) NFT over diverse stages, given those stages are coordinates with a common framework that bolsters decentralized character confirmation. In such a framework, we seem to have distinctive microservices APIs that connected with blockchain systems and permit different stages to confirm your KYC NFT.

5. How do I apply for a KYC NFT?

For Desktop Users:

  1. Visit the Web App: Open your browser and click here to access ICBKYC.
  2. Install MetaMask: If you haven’t installed MetaMask yet, please download and install the MetaMask browser extension for your preferred browser.
  3. Connect MetaMask: Once installed, open MetaMask and follow the prompts to set up or unlock your wallet.
  4. Sign In: After connecting your MetaMask wallet, sign in to ICBKYC. A signature request will be generated for you to authorize the connection

For Mobile Users:

  1. Download MetaMask App: Install the MetaMask app from the App Store or Google Play Store.
  2. Connect MetaMask: Open the MetaMask app, and either create a new wallet or unlock your existing one.
  3. Search Bar: Click on search bar and then copy and paste the following URL into the search bar: https://web.icbkyc.io/ to access ICBKYC.
  4. Sign In: After setting up MetaMask, connect your wallet to ICBVerse and sign the signature request to authenticate your account.
